DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 紙袋を拾われたのですね。どこにあったか教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You found a paper bag. Could you tell me where it was?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 歩道の端にありました。口が少し開いていて布が見えましたが、自分では中を取り出していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 歩道の紙袋に布が見えたが中身を取り出していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It was at the edge of the pavement. The opening was slightly open and I could see some fabric, but I did not take anything out myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you saw fabric in a paper bag on the pavement but did not remove its contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見えたものと確認していないものを区別します。歩道の近くに目印はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will distinguish what you saw from what has not been checked. Were there any landmarks near the pavement?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 横断歩道の手前で、閉まっている店の前です。店名は覚えていませんが、道順なら説明できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 横断歩道前の閉店中の店前で名前は不明だが道順を説明できると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was before a pedestrian crossing, in front of a closed shop. I do not remember the shop's name, but I can explain the directions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that it was outside a closed shop before a crossing; you do not know the name but can explain the route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 道順を伺いましょう。店から袋が出たと分かる事情はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me the route. Was there anything indicating that the bag had come from that shop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そういうことは分かりません。店の前にあっただけなので、その店の物だとは思い込まずに持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 店前にあっただけで店の物とは断定できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not know anything like that. It was merely in front of the shop, so I brought it here without assuming it belonged to that shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that being outside the shop does not establish that it belongs to the shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 場所の情報として記録します。見つけた時間はどのように覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record that as location information. How do you remember the time when you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人への電話を終えた直後でした。履歴を見ると午前十時十二分なので、その後です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人との電話直後で履歴の十時十二分より後だと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was just after I finished a call to a friend. The call history shows 10:12 in the morning, so it was after that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that it was immediately after your friend's call, later than 10:12 shown in the call history. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 履歴を手がかりに時刻を確認できますね。ここへ来るまで袋の中を確かめましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The call history can help confirm the time. Did you check inside the bag before coming here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 持ち手を持って運んだだけです。見えた布以外の中身は分からないので、こちらで確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 運んだだけで布以外は不明なので窓口で確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I only carried it by the handles. I do not know what is inside apart from the fabric I saw, so please check it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask the counter staff to check it because you only carried it and know nothing of the contents beyond the fabric. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのままお預かりして確認します。道順と時刻を伺いますね。届けてくださり助かりました。お気をつけてお帰りいただければと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take it as it is and check it. I will ask about the route and time. Thank you for bringing it in. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申込みの控えを見直されたのですね。どの部分が気になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You reviewed your application copy. Which part concerned you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旧住所の町名が、以前の書類と一文字違って見えます。自分が間違えて入力したかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 町名の漢字が一文字違い自分の入力ミスかもしれないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: One character in the town name of my former address looks different from my older documents. I may have entered it incorrectly myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that one kanji in the town name differs and may be your input error. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 控えと住所の資料を見比べましょう。新しい住所にも気になる点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us compare the copy and address documents. Is there anything concerning you about the new address too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 新住所は部屋番号まで合っています。気になるのは旧住所の漢字だけなので、そこを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新住所は部屋番号まで合い旧町名の漢字だけ確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The new address is correct, including the room number. Only the kanji in my former address concerns me, so I would like to check that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the new address, including the room number, is correct and you only want to check the old town-name kanji. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 旧住所の情報を確認してから、申込み内容の扱いをご案内します。以前の住所が分かるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: After checking the former address information, I will explain how the application will be handled. Do you have anything showing your former address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 古い封筒を持ってきました。手書きのメモより確かだと思いましたが、これで照合できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 古い封筒を持参し住所確認に使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I brought an old envelope. I thought it was more reliable than a handwritten note. Can it be used for comparison?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you brought an old envelope and ask whether it can be used to verify the address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 資料として拝見し、ほかに確認が必要かも調べます。同じ内容をもう一度申し込む予定でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will look at it as reference material and check whether anything else is needed. Were you planning to submit the same application again?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 初めはやり直そうと思いました。でも重ねて申し込む前に、修正の方法を尋ねることにしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: やり直しを考えたが重ねる前に修正方法を相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: At first I thought I should start again. But I decided to ask how to correct it before making a duplicate application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you considered starting again but will ask about correction before submitting a duplicate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付状況と確認の方法を調べてから、次の行動を案内します。差出人への住所連絡も進めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will explain the next step after checking the application's status and the verification method. Are you also notifying senders of your address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族には知らせましたが、定期便の会社にはまだです。申込みの相談とは別に、会社へ新住所を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族は連絡済みで定期便会社へ申込み相談と別に新住所を知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have told my family, but not the regular delivery company yet. Separately from this application consultation, I will give the company my new address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that your family has been informed and you will separately notify the regular delivery company of your new address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では控えと古い封筒を照合しましょう。確認した内容を残しておきます。資料をお返ししますので、帰宅後も保管しておいてください。またのご相談もお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us compare the application copy and the old envelope. I will keep a record of what we confirm. I will return the documents, so please keep them at home too. We welcome any further questions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの口座の住所を変えたいとのことですね。確認する口座は一つでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to change the address on your account. Is there just one account to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この口座の相談に来ましたが、もう一つ持っていることを思い出しました。一度の手続きで両方変わるか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一つの相談に来たが別口座もあり一度で両方反映するか不明だと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came to ask about this account, but remembered that I have another one. I do not know whether one procedure changes both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you came about one account but also have another, and do not know whether one procedure updates both. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座と登録の関係を確認してからご案内します。二つ目の情報は手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will explain after checking how the accounts and registrations are linked. Do you have the second account's details with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二つ目の書類は家です。番号を覚えていないので、適当に書かずに確認してから出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 書類は家で番号不明のため推測せず確認後に出したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The documents for the second account are at home. I do not remember the number, so I would like to check it before submitting it instead of writing a guess.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the documents are at home and, since you do not know the number, you want to verify it rather than guess. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 正確な情報をそろえましょう。通知の送付先も二つとも変えたいご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us gather accurate information. Do you also want the mailing addresses for notices changed for both accounts?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 両方とも今の自宅にしたいです。片方だけ旧住所に残ると、通知を受け取れないのではないかと心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: どちらも新自宅へ通知してほしく一方が旧住所に残るのが心配だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like both sent to my current home. I worry that if one stays at the old address, I may not receive its notices.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you want notices for both accounts sent to your new home and worry that one might remain at the old address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どの登録が変わるかと確認方法を、担当が案内します。今日は手元の口座について相談を進めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The responsible staff will explain which registrations change and how to check. Shall we proceed with the account you have here today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず、この口座で必要な準備を知りたいです。その説明を聞いてから、もう一つの書類を用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手元口座の必要準備を聞いた後でもう一つの書類を用意すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: First I want to know what preparations this account needs. After hearing that explanation, I will prepare the other account's documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will prepare the second account's documents after hearing what is required for the account at hand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更の範囲をまとめて確認できます。二つ目を相談する際に伝えることもメモしておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can check the scope of the changes together. Let us also note what to tell the staff when discussing the second account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの口座を持つことと、どちらの通知も新住所へ希望することをメモします。反映した範囲も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二口座と両方の送付希望を記録し反映範囲も確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note that I have two accounts and want notices for both sent to the new address. I will also confirm the scope of the updates actually made.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will record the two accounts and your mailing request for both, and check which changes took effect. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では手元の情報から拝見します。もう一つの資料がそろったら、改めてご相談ください。ご自宅での確認が済むのをお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let me see the information you have. Please consult us again when you have the other documents ready. We will wait until you have checked them at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 小分けの商品をお探しですね。どの表示を確かめたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking for individually portioned products. Which label information would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場へ持っていきたいですが、外箱は持ちません。小さい袋にも原材料と保存方法が書いてあるか気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 職場へ箱なしで持つため袋に原材料と保存情報があるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to take them to work without the outer box. I wonder whether the small packets also show the ingredients and storage instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the packets show ingredients and storage information because you will take them to work without the box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外箱と個包装の表示を分けて見ましょう。売場で開けずに確認できる案内を探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us look separately at the outer-box and individual-wrapper labels. I will look for information we can check without opening the product in the shop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 箱を開けて見るつもりはありません。見本や商品説明で分かるなら、見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱は開けず見本や商品説明で情報を見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not intend to open the box to look. If a sample or product description can tell us, could you show me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want information from a sample or product description without opening the box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見本の有無を調べます。個包装に情報がなかった場合は、どう持っていくお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check whether there is a sample. How would you take it if the individual packets did not have the information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 必要な表示を残せないなら、箱も持つか別の商品にします。記憶だけで保存方法を決めたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 情報が残らなければ箱を持つか別品にし記憶で保存を決めないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I cannot keep the necessary label information, I will take the box too or choose another product. I do not want to rely only on memory to decide how to store it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will take the box or another product if information cannot be retained, and will not decide storage from memory. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示を確認できる持ち方を選びましょう。職場で保管する場所についても条件がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us choose a way to carry it that keeps the label available. Are there also conditions concerning storage at work?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 冷蔵する場所は使えるか分かりません。先に商品に必要な保管方法を見て、職場にも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 冷蔵場所が不明で商品表示を見て職場へ確かめると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not know whether a refrigerated space is available. I will first look at the storage method required for the product, then check with my workplace too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that refrigerated storage is uncertain and you will check the product label and then your workplace. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保管場所が決まるまで、購入を待つこともできます。どれくらいの量を持っていく予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can also wait to buy it until the storage location is settled. How much do you plan to take?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二回分だけです。表示と職場の保管場所を確かめ、条件が合う量の商品を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二回分の量を希望し表示と職場保管が合う商品を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Only enough for two occasions. I will check the label and the storage space at work, and choose a product in a quantity that suits the conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you want enough for two occasions and will choose a product that fits both the label requirements and workplace storage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では箱の表示と商品案内から見ましょう。確認できた内容を持ち方にも生かしてください。また商品選びで迷ったら、お声をかけてくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us start with the box label and product information. Use the confirmed information when deciding how to carry it too. Please ask again if you are unsure which product to choose.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地図の文字が見えにくかったですか。口頭で経路を説明しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Was the lettering on the map difficult to see? Shall I explain the route verbally?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さい文字を読むのが難しいので、短い道を言葉で教えてください。一度に長く説明されると覚えられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小文字が見えにくく長い説明を覚えにくいため短い道を言葉で尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Small letters are hard for me to read, so please describe a short route in words. I cannot remember a long explanation all at once.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask verbally for a short route because small lettering is hard to see and long explanations are hard to remember. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 短い区間ごとに説明します。最初は入口から休憩場所までの案内でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will explain it in short sections. Shall we start with the route from the entrance to a rest area?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それがよいです。曲がるところと、座れる場所の目印を一つずつ聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口から休憩まで曲がる箇所と座る場所を一つずつ聞きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: That would be good. I would like to hear the turns and a landmark for somewhere to sit, one at a time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want to hear the turns and a place to sit individually along the entrance-to-rest-area route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 実際の案内で目印を確かめましょう。聞いたあと、ご自身の言葉で確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check landmarks using the actual guidance. After listening, could you confirm it in your own words?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 言い直して確かめたいです。違っていたら、その部分だけもう一度説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分で復唱し違う部分だけ再説明してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to repeat it to check. If I am wrong, please explain just that part again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to repeat it yourself and have only the incorrect part explained again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分けて確認しましょう。休憩後は続けて歩く予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check it in sections. Do you plan to keep walking after resting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ決めていません。疲れたら入口へ戻りたいので、休憩場所から戻る案内も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 続けるか未定で疲れたら戻るため休憩場所から入口への案内を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not decided yet. If I get tired, I want to return to the entrance, so I would also like directions back from the rest area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for directions from the rest area back to the entrance because continuing is undecided and you may return if tired. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 行きと戻りを分けて説明します。目印が見つからないときは、探して遠くまで進まず相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will explain the outward and return routes separately. If you cannot find a landmark, please ask instead of wandering far in search of it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口から休憩までを言い直し、戻る道も確認します。目印が分からなければ、案内所へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 行きと帰りを確認し目印不明なら案内所へ相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will repeat the route from the entrance to the rest area and check the route back too. If I cannot identify a landmark, I will ask at the information desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check both directions and consult the information desk if a landmark is unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では最初の区間から説明しますね。ご自分のペースで確かめながらお進みください。心が休まる散歩になりますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will begin with the first section. Please proceed at your own pace, checking as you go. I hope you have a peaceful walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: バスに乗る前の道順についてでしょうか。降りたい停留所の名前はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the route before taking the bus? Do you have the name of the stop where you want to get off?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このメモの停留所です。あまり長く歩きたくないので、入口のすぐ前で待てばよいと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 歩行を減らしたいため入口前を選んだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is the stop on this note. I do not want to walk very far, so I think I should wait right in front of the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you chose the spot in front of the entrance to reduce walking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この図では、入口前の停留所は反対方向です。メモの行き先へは、道路の向こう側から乗る案内になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this map, the stop outside the entrance is for the opposite direction. The guidance says to board across the road for the destination on your note.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 近い所から乗ればよいわけではないのですね。反対側へ行く、歩きやすい経路を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 近い停留所を目的の便と思い込まない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So boarding at the nearest stop is not necessarily right. Please show me an easy walking route to the other side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not assume that the nearby stop serves your intended bus. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 図にある横断する場所を通る経路を確認しましょう。直線で近く見えても、車道をそのまま渡る案にはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check a route using the crossing shown on the map. Even if it looks close in a straight line, we cannot plan to cross the roadway directly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 横断する場所まで歩いて回ります。出発まで時間があるので、先に座って休んでから向かいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 直線で渡らず移動に備えて待合所を使う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will walk around to the crossing. There is time before departure, so I would like to sit and rest first, then go there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use the waiting area to prepare for the walk instead of crossing directly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 待合場所の案内はここです。休んだあとは、停留所まで移動する時間も残しておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is the information for the waiting area. After resting, make sure to leave enough time to get to the stop too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待っている時間を全部休憩に使わないようにします。向こう側に着いたら、バスの行き先の表示も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 向こう側で行き先表示も照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will avoid using all the waiting time for rest. When I get to the other side, I also want to check the destination display on the bus.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare the destination display on the other side too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、停留所の案内と車両の表示を照合してください。乗る便がわからなければ、乗車前に係へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, compare the stop information with the vehicle's display. If you do not know which service to take, check with staff before boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 休んでから図の横断経路で向こう側へ行きます。停留所名と行き先を確かめ、迷ったら乗る前に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 目的のバスが未確認なら乗車前に聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: After resting, I will follow the crossing route on the map to the other side. I will check the stop name and destination, and ask before boarding if unsure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask before boarding if your intended bus is not yet confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 近さと行き先を分けて考えられましたね。横断するときは周囲をよく確かめて、バスでのお出かけをお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have separated closeness from destination. Check your surroundings carefully when crossing, and enjoy your bus trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所の手続きに関するご相談ですね。新しい住まいには、もう生活の拠点を移されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about address procedures. Have you already moved your main place of living to the new home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先週から住んでいます。契約書の日付は先月なので、どの日を説明すればよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: どの時点を手続きで伝えるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have lived there since last week. The contract is dated last month, so I am unsure which day to explain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which point in time you should report for the procedure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 契約した日と実際に住み始めた日は、分けて担当者へ伝えてください。申請欄に何を記入するかは、その内容を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tell the responsible staff the contract date and the date you actually started living there separately. We will explain what to enter in the application fields after checking that information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先月契約して、荷物を運んだのが先週です。その夜から生活しています。契約日を自分で転入日と決めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 契約書の日を独断で転入日としない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I signed the contract last month and moved my belongings last week. I have lived there since that night. I will not decide on my own that the contract date is the move-in date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not unilaterally treat the contract date as the move-in date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その経緯をお話しください。前の自治体から受け取った案内や書類はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please explain that sequence of events. Do you have the guidance or documents you received from your former municipality?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内を持っていますが、紙の名前が難しくて、必要な物かはわかりません。封筒ごと担当者に見せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 封筒を含め必要書類か確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the guidance, but the document names are difficult and I do not know whether these are the required papers. I would like to show the staff the whole envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the staff to check whether the required documents are present, including the envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中身を確認してもらいましょう。ご本人の確認に使うものと、現在の住所がわかるものもお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us have the contents checked. Do you also have something for identity verification and something showing your current address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 在留カードと契約書があります。どちらに古い住所が残っているかも説明し、ほかに必要な物を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現状と書類の住所を照合して不足を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my residence card and contract. I will also explain which still shows my old address, and ask what else is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare your actual circumstances with the addresses on the documents and ask what is missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書類の表記と実際の状況を分けて伝えると確認しやすいですね。保険など、関連する相談もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is easier to check if you distinguish what is written on the documents from the actual situation. Do you have related questions, such as insurance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社の保険の案内はまだ確認中です。そのことも伝え、住所の手続きと別に相談が必要か教えてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所以外の関連手続きを状況に応じて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I am still checking the information about my company's insurance. I will say that too and ask whether I need a separate consultation from the address procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check any related procedures beyond the address according to your situation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つの日付とお持ちの資料が整理できましたね。封筒も忘れず担当へお持ちになり、説明を確かめてからお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have organized the two dates and the documents you have. Do not forget to take the envelope to the staff, and confirm their explanation before leaving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約変更のご希望を担当へ伝える前に、来られる候補を確認しましょう。曜日の希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before I pass on your request to change the appointment, let us check possible dates you can come. Do you prefer a particular weekday?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 水曜日なら休みだと思っていましたが、勤務が隔週でした。曜日だけで変更を頼みかけてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 水曜が毎週休みではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I was off on Wednesdays, but my shifts alternate weekly. I nearly asked for a change based only on the weekday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are not off every Wednesday. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ水曜日でも週によって違うのですね。勤務表と予約票の日付を一緒に見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: So even Wednesdays differ depending on the week. Please look at your work roster and the date on your appointment slip together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予約のある週の水曜は仕事で、その次の水曜は休みです。休みの週の日付を第一希望にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 休みの水曜を具体的な変更候補にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I work on the Wednesday in my appointment week, but am off the following Wednesday. I would like the date in my week off to be my first choice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the specific Wednesday you are off as a proposed replacement date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 具体的な日付で伝えると行き違いを防げます。その日が難しい場合に、別の候補はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Giving a specific date helps prevent misunderstandings. If that date is difficult, do you have another option?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ週の金曜も休みですが、午後だけ来られます。水曜は時間の希望がなく、金曜は午後という違いがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 代案ごとに来られる時間を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am also off on Friday of the same week, but can only come in the afternoon. I have no time preference on Wednesday, whereas Friday must be in the afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the available times separately for each alternative. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 候補ごとの条件を担当へお伝えください。前回と比べて体調に変化があれば、日付の相談と一緒に話してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please give the staff the conditions for each possible date. If your condition has changed since last time, explain that along with the date request.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今のところ前回と同じですが、変化があれば知らせます。希望の日まで待ってよいかも、担当の方に確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務の希望だけで延期を決めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: At present it is the same as last time, but I will report any change. I would also like the staff to confirm whether it is all right to wait until my preferred date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not decide to postpone based only on your work preferences. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受診時期の判断や予約の空きは、担当者の確認が必要です。勤務の都合だけで新しい日が決まったと考えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff need to check both the appropriate consultation timing and appointment availability. Please do not assume a new date is settled solely because it fits your work schedule.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 勤務表の具体的な日付を示して返答を待ちます。決まったら週も確かめ、仕事のある水曜と取り違えないように控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 隔週の取り違えを防いで予約回答を控える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the specific dates on my roster and wait for the reply. Once it is settled, I will check the week too and record it so I do not confuse it with the Wednesday I work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record the appointment reply while preventing confusion between alternating weeks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 隔週の違いを日付で伝える準備ができましたね。勤務表と予約票を担当へお見せになって、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: You are ready to explain the alternate-week difference using dates. Please show your roster and appointment slip to the staff. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車の写真をお持ちですね。見当たらない車体は、いまもこの写真と同じ状態でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a photo of your bicycle. Is the missing bicycle still in the same condition as in this photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この写真は買ったときの物です。その後に塗り直したので、写真では赤ですが、いまは灰色です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 塗装後の車体を古い写真と同一に扱わない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: This photo was taken when I bought it. I repainted it afterward, so it is red in the photo but gray now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Do not treat the repainted bicycle as identical to the old photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 色が変わった点を記録しましょう。変えていない部分にも、見分ける特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us record the change in color. Are there distinguishing features among the parts you have not changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前のかごとサドルはそのままです。サドルの端に破れがあり、かごの下に小さな銀色の札がついています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在の自転車を見分ける特徴を補う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The front basket and saddle are unchanged. The edge of the saddle is torn, and there is a small silver tag under the basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Add features that identify the bicycle in its current state. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の特徴がわかりました。最後に停めた場所と、そこへ戻ったときのことを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Now we know its current features. Please tell me where you last parked it and what happened when you returned.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨夕、店の裏の駐輪場に鍵をかけて停めました。今朝は同じ所にありません。管理者へ聞きましたが、移動は把握していないそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最後の場所と確認済みの情報を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yesterday evening, I locked and parked it in the bicycle parking area behind the shop. It was not in the same place this morning. I asked the manager, but they said they do not know of it being moved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the last location and the information you have already checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 管理者の返答も添えて確認します。防犯登録など、車体を特定する情報はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will include the manager's reply in the check. Do you have information identifying the bicycle, such as its anti-theft registration?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 書類は家で保管しています。登録番号は覚えていないので、写真の札から推測せず、帰って書類を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車体の札から登録番号を推定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I keep the documents at home. I do not remember the registration number, so I will not guess from the tag in the photo; I will check the documents when I get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not infer the registration number from a tag on the bicycle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確かな情報を確認してから伝えてください。古い写真は、違う箇所を説明したうえで担当者にお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please give us the information after checking it is reliable. Show the old photo to the staff with an explanation of the differences.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 赤は以前の色だと伝え、いまの灰色と残った特徴を説明します。書類の情報も確かめ、停めた場所と管理者の回答を一緒に話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 古い写真を説明付きで担当へ示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain that red was the old color, and describe the current gray color and remaining features. I will also check the document information and explain the parking location together with the manager's response.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the old photo to the staff with an explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 昔の写真と現在の姿を分けて説明できましたね。担当の案内を受け、確認に戻る際はお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have explained the old photo and current appearance separately. Please follow the staff's guidance, and take care on your way home when you go back to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒の宛先を書き終えたところでしょうか。お手元の二枚の案内は同じ送り先ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you just finished addressing the envelope? Do the two sets of instructions you have give the same destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 去年の封筒から写しました。でも今年の案内には別の建物が書かれていて、担当部署も違うようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写した住所が今回の部署と合うか疑問を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I copied it from last year's envelope. But this year's guidance names a different building and seems to have a different department too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Express doubt about whether the copied address matches the department for this submission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回の提出先を先に確認しましょう。郵便窓口では、どの部署が受け付けるかまでは決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us confirm the destination for this submission first. The post office counter cannot decide which department accepts the documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前の場所へ送れば渡してもらえると思っていましたが、そう決めずに、今年の案内の問い合わせ先へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今年の問い合わせ先で宛先を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought sending it to the previous place would get it passed on, but I will not assume that. I will ask the contact listed in this year's instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the destination with this year's contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 宛先が確定してから記入してください。発送の記録について、今回の案内に指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please write the address after it is confirmed. Do this year's instructions specify anything about records of sending it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受け付けた記録を残すようあります。届いたことまで確認できる方法も知りたいですが、二つを同じ意味と思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内の指定と追加の確認方法を分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: They say to keep a record of acceptance. I also want to know a method that confirms delivery, but I will not treat those two as meaning the same thing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate the required record in the guidance from additional confirmation methods. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 方法ごとの記録と利用条件を説明できます。どちらを提出先が求めるか確認したら、料金も比べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I can explain the records and conditions for each method. Once you check which the recipient requires, let us compare the fees too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 必要な記録を先に聞きます。それから新しい住所と部署名で、宛先の書き方を見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新住所と部署名で宛先表記を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will first ask what record is required. Then I would like you to check how I have addressed it using the new address and department name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the addressee wording using the new address and department name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しい案内と照合して確認しましょう。中身と差出人の情報はご自身でも確かめ、控えを残してから封をしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us compare it with the new instructions. Please also check the contents and sender information yourself, and keep copies before sealing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 古い封筒は見本に使わず、回答のあった宛先を転記します。記録の条件と料金を確かめ、書類の控えを残して送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 古い見本に頼らず条件確認後に発送する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not use the old envelope as a model; I will copy the address confirmed in the reply. I will check the record requirements and fees, keep copies of the documents, and send them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Send it after checking the conditions without relying on the old model. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今年の提出先で確認する順序が決まりましたね。発送の控えも大切にお持ちになって、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have established the order for checking this year's recipient. Please keep the mailing receipt carefully and take care on your way home.
